article_manifest.title: General mobilisation for the defence of the homeland: NGOs and CSOs made aware of their responsibility
article_manifest.original_title: Mobilisation générale pour la défense de la patrie : Les ONG et OSC édifiées sur leur responsabilité
article_manifest.summary: On Tuesday, 24 November 2020, the Commission responsible for organising, preparing and monitoring the implementation of the general mobilisation for the defence of the homeland (COMOG) met with the heads of non-governmental organisations and stakeholders from Nigerien civil society. The aim is to enable these organisations to take ownership of the concept and implications of general mobilisation, but also to educate them about their role as intermediaries through awareness-raising activities.

article_manifest.title: جبهة أزواد تبدأ استعدادات لإطلاق مواجهة محتملة مع الجيش المالي
article_manifest.original_title: جبهة أزواد تبدأ استعدادات لإطلاق مواجهة محتملة مع الجيش المالي
article_manifest.summary: نبّه بيان إلى خطر من اندلاع مواجهات مسلحة خلال الأيام المقبلة دعت أزواد المدنيين إلى الابتعاد مواقع الفيلق الإفريقي أعلنت قيادات في جبهة تحرير أزواد الاستعداد لخوض معارك ومواجهات مع الجيش المالي وقوات الفيلق الأفريقي التي تتبع روسيا في مناطق شمال مالي، بعد التقدم الذي يحققه جيش الأخيرة في المنطقة منذ نجاحه في السيطرة على مدينة كيدال، أبرز مدن شمال مالي بداية شهر أكتوبر/ تشرين الأول الماضي، في أعقاب قرار قوات أزواد الانسحاب التكتيكي من المدينة.

article_manifest.title: Promotion dans les armées : Trois colonels promus généraux de brigade
article_manifest.original_title: Promotion dans les armées : Trois colonels promus généraux de brigade
article_manifest.summary: Selon un communiqué de la Direction de l’information et des relations publiques des armées (DIRPA), trois colonels des forces armées sénégalaises ont été promus au grade de général de brigade à compter du 3 décembre 2026. Des nominations qui interviennent dans le cadre des promotions au sein de la hiérarchie militaire sénégalaise. Il s’agit des colonels Amadou Makhtar Ndiaye, directeur général du Centre des hautes études de défense et de sécurité (CHEDS) ; de Thierno Ndour, chef de cabinet du ministre des Forces armées ; et du médecin-colonel Abdou Razack Ndiaye, directeur du Service de santé des armées.

article_manifest.title: Armée Sénégalaise : Les Colonels Amadou Makhtar Ndiaye, Thierno Ndour et le Pr Abdou Razack Ndiaye promus Généraux (DIRPA)
article_manifest.original_title: Armée Sénégalaise : Les Colonels Amadou Makhtar Ndiaye, Thierno Ndour et le Pr Abdou Razack Ndiaye promus Généraux (DIRPA)
article_manifest.summary: L'Armée sénégalaise s'apprête à accueillir trois nouveaux généraux à compter du 3 décembre 2026. Selon la Direction de l'Information et des Relations publiques des Armées (DIRPA), les colonels Amadou Makhtar Ndiaye et Thierno Ndour, ainsi que le médecin-colonel Professeur Abdou Razack Ndiaye, vont accéder au grade de général. Parmi les promus figure le colonel Amadou Makhtar Ndiaye, appelé à occuper les fonctions de Directeur général du Centre des Hautes Études de Défense et de Sécurité (CHEDS) en remplacement du Général Jean Diémé.

article_manifest.title: Mali : les FAMa neutralisent une dizaine de terroristes
article_manifest.original_title: Mali : les FAMa neutralisent une dizaine de terroristes
article_manifest.summary: Les Forces armées maliennes (FAMa) ont annoncé avoir neutralisé au moins une dizaine de combattants terroristes et mis hors d’usage sept motocyclettes lors de frappes menées les 23 et 24 novembre dans plusieurs régions du pays, notamment dans le cadre de la traque des auteurs de l’attaque contre Niono. Dans un communiqué publié mardi, l’État-major général des Armées indique que ces interventions ont été conduites dans le cadre de l’opération Dougoukoloko, avec l’appui de partenaires, à travers des actions de surveillance, de reconnaissance et de frappes ciblées contre des positions de groupes armés.

article_manifest.title: Mali: Assimi Goïta brings the high military command together to discuss security priorities
article_manifest.original_title: Mali : Assimi Goïta réunit le haut commandement militaire autour des priorités sécuritaires
article_manifest.summary: The Transitional President, Head of State and Supreme Commander of the Armed Forces, Army General Assimi Goïta, chaired a meeting with the Chiefs of Staff and Directors of Services of the Defence and Security Forces on Tuesday, 24 November 2026, at the Koulouba Palace. . This meeting was devoted to assessing the situation of the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), strengthening their operational capabilities and defining the strategic directions for national defence.

article_manifest.title: Guinea: The fight against illegal gold mining extended to the whole country
article_manifest.original_title: Guinée : la lutte contre l'orpaillage illégal étendue à tout le pays
article_manifest.summary: The Guinean authorities are expanding their offensive against illegal gold mining. In a joint statement issued on 23 November 2026 in Conakry, six ministries announced that the operations, which were launched in the Siguiri region, are now being extended to the entire country. .

article_manifest.title: الطوراق استعملوها ضد الروس على حدود مالي مع الجزائر… مسيرات رخيصة تغير قواعد القتال لصالح المتمردين في أفريقيا منذ 3 ساعات
article_manifest.original_title: الطوراق استعملوها ضد الروس على حدود مالي مع الجزائر… مسيرات رخيصة تغير قواعد القتال لصالح المتمردين في أفريقيا منذ 3 ساعات
article_manifest.summary: داكار: تنحرف طائرة مسيرة ملغومة رباعية المراوح بشدة وتستهدف مركبة عسكرية روسية ثم تنقض عليها لتدميرها، وتحوم مسيرة أخرى فوق مطار، وتخطئ ضربة بفارق ضئيل نفاثة لكنها تصيب ثلاثة رجال قيل إنهم روس. وصارت مقاطع فيديو تظهر فيها طائرات تنقل إلى مشغليها صورا مباشرة لما تراه كاميراتها أثناء استهداف قوات روسية مشهدا مألوفا مع استمرار الحرب في أوكرانيا. لكن هذه المقاطع ليست من أوكرانيا، بل من مالي التي تبعد عنها خمسة آلاف كيلومتر عند أطراف الصحراء الكبرى.

article_manifest.title: Agadez: The Governor chairs a regular meeting of the Regional Security Council (RSC)
article_manifest.original_title: Agadez : Le Gouverneur préside une réunion ordinaire du Conseil Régional de Sécurité (CRS)
article_manifest.summary: Agadez, 25 November (ANP) – The Governor of the Agadez Region, Major General Ibra Boulama Issa, chaired an ordinary meeting of the Regional Security Council (CRS) on Wednesday, 25 November 2026, in the Governor's Office meeting room. Several items were on the agenda for this meeting, including an assessment of the security situation in the region and various other matters.

article_manifest.title: Attack in Niono: FAMa are tracking down the attackers, with around ten terrorists neutralised
article_manifest.original_title: Attaque de Niono : les FAMa traquent les assaillants, une dizaine de terroristes neutralisés
article_manifest.summary: Niono attack: FAMa hunt down the attackers, around ten terrorists neutralised Operation Dougoukoloko saw FAMa and their partners carry out airstrikes in several Malian regions on 23 and 24 November 2026. In particular, they are continuing to hunt down the perpetrators of the attack on Niono. According to the General Staff of the Armed Forces, at least a dozen terrorists have been neutralised and seven motorbikes have been put out of use.

article_manifest.original_title: Opération Dougoukoloko : les FAMa neutralisent...
article_manifest.summary: Operation Dougoukoloko: The Malian Armed Forces (FAMa) neutralise several terrorists and destroy logistical resources in various regions. The Malian Armed Forces (FAMa) are continuing their operations to secure the national territory as part of Operation Dougoukoloko. .

article_manifest.title: Sécurisation routière : le Commissariat de Police de Dièma interpelle un suspect de braquage sur l’axe Dièma–Kayes
article_manifest.original_title: Sécurisation routière : le Commissariat de Police de Dièma interpelle un suspect de braquage sur l’axe Dièma–Kayes
article_manifest.summary: La vigilance des services de police a permis une nouvelle intervention sur l’axe routier Dièma-Kayes. Le 19 novembre 2026, le Commissariat de Police de Dièma, dirigé par le Commissaire de Police Djibril SANOU, a procédé à l’interpellation d’un individu suspecté d’être impliqué dans un braquage, dans le cadre des actions de sécurisation impulsées par le Contrôleur Principal de Police Ousmane DIALLO, Directeur Régional de la Police Nationale de Nioro du Sahel.

article_manifest.title: FAMa strikes in Nioro, Niono, Tonka, Debelin, Kidal, Dandougou and Sofara: several terrorists neutralised
article_manifest.original_title: Frappes des FAMa à Nioro, Niono, Tonka, Debelin, Kidal, Dandougou et Sofara : plusieurs terroristes neutralisés
article_manifest.summary: The General Staff of the Armed Forces informs the national public that the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), supported by their partners, are continuing their ongoing operations to monitor, control and secure the national territory as part of Operation Dougoukoloko. . On 23 and 24 November 2023, the FAMa carried out a series of strikes in several regions of the country, in particular continuing the hunt for the perpetrators of the attack on Niono.

article_manifest.title: Attackers kill 11 Niger soldiers in Diffa region
article_manifest.original_title: Attackers kill 11 Niger soldiers in Diffa region
article_manifest.summary: FILE: Nigerien special forces secure the Iferouane area during the Festival de l’Aïr in Niger, December 2, 2022. /VCG Boko Haram fighters on Tuesday, November 24, attacked a patrol in southeast Niger, killing 11 soldiers and wounding five others, the defense ministry said in a statement. The attack occurred near the village of Baroua in the Diffa region, it said.

article_manifest.title: Niono: The hospital is treating the injured despite the damage
article_manifest.original_title: Niono : l’hôpital soigne les blessés malgré les dégâts
article_manifest.summary: CURRENTLY On 21 November, teams from Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF) and their colleagues from the Ministry of Health treated 26 injured people in Niono, in the Ségou region. They were working in a facility that was itself affected during the clashes. MSF reports two deaths during the violence that took place that day in Niono and Arabébé, near Niafounké, including a member of the healthcare staff.

article_manifest.title: Axe Dièma-Kayes : un braqueur présumé arrêté près de Madina
article_manifest.original_title: Axe Dièma-Kayes : un braqueur présumé arrêté près de Madina
article_manifest.summary: Le commissariat de police de Dièma a arrêté, le 19 novembre 2026, un jeune homme de 26 ans soupçonné de braquages sur l'axe Dièma-Kayes. Identifié par les initiales A.S., il a été interpellé près du village de Madina, après plusieurs signalements d'attaques sur cette route. Selon les enquêteurs, le suspect agissait avec un complice.

article_manifest.title: Terrorist attack in Niono and strike in higher education: The CNDH-Mali calls for the protection of civilians and for social dialogue
article_manifest.original_title: Attaque terroriste de Niono et grève de l’Enseignement supérieur : La CNDH-Mali appelle à la protection des civils et au dialogue social
article_manifest.summary: On 24 November 2026, the National Human Rights Commission (CNDH) issued two press releases, one on the attacks on civilian targets in Niono and the other on the indefinite strike by higher education and scientific research lecturers. In these two statements, the Commission calls for the protection of fundamental rights, the accountability of the stakeholders concerned, and dialogue.

article_manifest.title: Mali: JNIM jihadists issue an ultimatum to the inhabitants of Tonk
article_manifest.original_title: Mali: Les jihadistes du Jnim lancent un ultimatum aux habitants de Tonk
article_manifest.summary: In Mali, the al-Qaeda-linked Jnim is giving the inhabitants of Tonka until Friday to leave the town, after which this locality in the Timbuktu region will be placed under blockade. The jihadists are reacting to the deployment in the town of a detachment of the Malian army and its Russian partners from the Africa Corps. In the space of a year, JNIM has murdered several civilians in Tonka for their supposed links to the army.

article_manifest.title: Mali: Près de 350 combattants russes tués en trois ans, selon une enquête du Guardian
article_manifest.original_title: Mali: Près de 350 combattants russes tués en trois ans, selon une enquête du Guardian
article_manifest.summary: Près de 350 combattants russes ont perdu la vie au Mali entre septembre 2023 et septembre 2026, selon des données de l'agence nationale russe des statistiques (Rosstat), obtenues par deux groupes de hackers, Cyber Partisans et Silent Crow, et analysées par le quotidien britannique The Guardian. Le journal indique avoir pu associer la majorité des décès recensés à des affrontements connus.

article_manifest.title: Operation Dougoukoloko: 34 terrorists neutralised and significant logistical resources destroyed by FAMa
article_manifest.original_title: Opération Dougoukoloko : 34 terroristes neutralisés et d’importants moyens logistiques détruits par les FAMa
article_manifest.summary: The General Staff of the Armed Forces informs the nation that the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), supported by their partners, are continuing their ongoing operations to monitor, control and secure the national territory as part of Operation Dougoukoloko. Between 20 and 23 November 2026, the FAMa carried out a series of strikes against the logistical assets of armed terrorist groups.

article_manifest.title: Libye, Sahel, Soudan : comment l’Ukraine étend son empreinte militaire en Afrique
article_manifest.original_title: Libye, Sahel, Soudan : comment l’Ukraine étend son empreinte militaire en Afrique
article_manifest.summary: En frappant une corvette russe dans le port de Benghazi, Kiev a levé un peu plus le voile sur sa présence militaire en Libye. Du Maghreb au Sahel, l’Ukraine développe des partenariats sécuritaires pour contrer les intérêts de Moscou, mais aussi pour valoriser son expertise en matière de drones. À plusieurs milliers de kilomètres des côtes ukrainiennes, la guerre entre Kiev et Moscou se joue désormais jusque dans les ports africains.

article_manifest.title: Mali: Jnim jihadists issue an ultimatum to the inhabitants of Tonka, in the Timbuktu region
article_manifest.original_title: Mali: les jihadistes du Jnim lancent un ultimatum aux habitants de Tonka, dans la région de Tombouctou
article_manifest.summary: The voice messages were broadcast on Sunday, in several national languages: the JNIM is giving the inhabitants of Tonka who wish to leave five days, up to and including Friday, to do so. After this date, the jihadists are threatening to prevent all vehicles from entering or leaving the town. Even canoes will no longer be "allowed" to dock there.

article_manifest.title: Mali: JNIM jihadists issue an ultimatum to the inhabitants of Tonka, in the Timbuktu region
article_manifest.original_title: Mali: les jihadistes du Jnim lancent un ultimatum aux habitants de Tonka, dans la région de Tombouctou
article_manifest.summary: In Mali, Jnim, linked to al-Qaeda, has given the inhabitants of Tonka until Friday to leave the town, after which this locality in the Timbuktu region will be placed under blockade. The jihadists are reacting to the deployment in the town of a detachment of the Malian army and its Russian partners from the Africa Corps. .

article_manifest.title: Koulouba: Assimi Goïta meets with the military command
article_manifest.original_title: Koulouba: Assimi Goïta rencontre le commandement militaire
article_manifest.summary: Cette rencontre intervient dans un contexte marqué par des défis sécuritaires importants d’où les orientations du Chef suprême des Armées pour consolider la montée en puissance des FAMa et accroitre leur efficacité sur le terrain. Plusieurs chefs militaires étaient autour du président de la Transition non moins ministre de la Défense pour la circonstance. L’objectif affiché étant d’évaluer les forces armées et de sécurité, de renforcer la cohérence du commandement militaire et de définir les priorités stratégiques et opérationnelles.

article_manifest.title: Defence and security: The Transitional President holds discussions with the military command
article_manifest.original_title: Défense et sécurité : le président de la Transition échange avec le commandement militaire
article_manifest.summary: On Tuesday, 24 November 2020, in Koulouba, the Transitional President, Head of State and Supreme Commander of the Armed Forces, Army General Assimi Goïta, chaired a meeting with the Chiefs of Staff and the Directors of Services of the Defence and Security Forces. The aim of this meeting was to assess the situation of the forces, strengthen the coherence of the command structure, and define the strategic and operational priorities of national defence.

article_manifest.title: San: Police station attacked by armed men
article_manifest.original_title: San : le commissariat de police attaqué par des hommes armés
article_manifest.summary: Armed men attacked the police station in San on the afternoon of Tuesday, 24 November 2020, according to local sources. The Malian Armed Forces (FAMa) responded. According to the same sources, the gunfire has ceased and the situation is now under the control of the FAMa.

article_manifest.title: Abolish pipeline surveillance contracts
article_manifest.original_title: Abolish pipeline surveillance contracts
article_manifest.summary: There is something insanely absurd in having to incentivise any group of persons to restrain them from destroying assets in which they have significant stakes. This is even more so when the environmental costs of such destruction are considered. That absurdity writ large in Nigeria at the dawn of the Fourth Republic, under the term “Pipelines surveillance contracts”.

article_manifest.source: Timbuktu Institute (African Center for Peace Studies)
article_manifest.title: Jihadism in the Sahel: “The states of the region cannot remain in this situation of neither war nor peace forever”
article_manifest.original_title: Jihadisme au Sahel: «Les États de la région ne peuvent pas éternellement rester dans cette situation de ni guerre ni paix»
article_manifest.summary: Should we negotiate with the jihadists in the Sahel? With the ongoing conflict between the juntas of the Alliance of Sahel States (AES) and the al-Qaeda-linked terrorist group JNIM, the question is becoming less and less taboo, especially as the military solutions that have been in vogue for over a decade are not working. In a report published on Friday, 20 November, experts from the International Crisis Group (ICG) therefore recommend that the authorities in Bamako, Ouagadougou and Niamey open frank negotiations with him.

article_manifest.title: Operation Dougoukoloko: 34 terrorists neutralised and more than 90 motorbikes destroyed in four days
article_manifest.original_title: Opération Dougoukoloko : 34 terroristes neutralisés et plus de 90 motos détruites en quatre jours
article_manifest.summary: Between 20 and 23 November 2026, the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), supported by their partners, carried out a series of strikes against the logistics of terrorist groups, as part of Operation Dougoukoloko. . Report announced by the Armed Forces General Staff: 34 terrorists neutralised, one ammunition depot, one gold processing site, three pick-up trucks and more than 90 motorbikes destroyed.

article_manifest.title: Koulouba: The Supreme Commander of the Armed Forces convenes the military hierarchy to assess the security situation
article_manifest.original_title: Koulouba : Le Chef suprême des Armées réunit la hiérarchie militaire pour évaluer la situation sécuritaire
article_manifest.summary: DEFENCE AND SECURITY: The Transitional President holds discussions with the military command The Transitional President, Head of State and Supreme Commander of the Armed Forces, His Excellency Army General Assimi Goïta, chaired a meeting with the Chiefs of Staff and the Directors of Services of the Defence and Security Forces on Tuesday, 24 November 2020 at Koulouba.

article_manifest.title: MDAC: The 24 soldiers released following an air-land operation were received by the Minister Delegate
article_manifest.original_title: MDAC : les 24 militaires libérés à l’issue d’une opération aéroterrestre reçus par le Ministre délégué
article_manifest.summary: Following their release on Wednesday, 18 November 2026, in the In-Tebezas area near Kidal, the 24 soldiers who had previously been held hostage were received on Monday, 23 November 2026, by the Minister Delegate to the Minister of Defence and Veterans' Affairs, Major General Oumar Diarra. The meeting, which took place in the department's conference room, was attended by the Chief of the General Staff of the Armed Forces (CEMGA), Major General Élysée Jean DAO.

article_manifest.title: Burkina Faso: Mobile money scams cost over CFAF 104 million (October)
article_manifest.original_title: Burkina : les escroqueries au Mobile Money ont coûté plus de 104 millions FCFA (Octobre)
article_manifest.summary: Mobile money scams have become widespread in Burkina Faso. According to data provided by the Ministry of Security, Mobile Money scams claimed 263 victims in October, resulting in financial losses of around CFAF 104 million. These figures highlight the impact of digital fraud on the losses suffered by the population.

article_manifest.title: Defence and security: The Transitional President holds discussions with the military command
article_manifest.original_title: Défense et sécurité : Le Président de la Transition échange avec le commandement militaire
article_manifest.summary: The Transitional President, Head of State and Supreme Commander of the Armed Forces, His Excellency General of the Army Assimi Goïta, chaired a meeting with the Chiefs of Staff and the Directors of Services of the Defence and Security Forces on Tuesday, 24 November 2026, in Koulouba. . The aim of this meeting was to assess the situation of the forces, strengthen the coherence of the command structure, and define the strategic and operational priorities of national defence.

article_manifest.title: Koulouba: Assimi Goïta convenes military leaders to set defence priorities
article_manifest.original_title: Koulouba : Assimi Goïta réunit les chefs militaires pour fixer les priorités de défense
article_manifest.summary: The Transitional President, Army General Assimi Goïta, met with the Chiefs of Staff and the Directors of Services of the Defence and Security Forces on Tuesday, 24 November 2026, in Koulouba. On the agenda: the state of the armed forces, the organisation of the command structure and national defence priorities . Discussions focused on the situation of the FAMa, the strengthening of their resources, and the adaptation of their organisation to the fight against insecurity.

article_manifest.title: Ségou: Three suspects arrested in connection with the murder of a young man in Markala
article_manifest.original_title: Ségou : trois suspects arrêtés dans l’affaire de l’assassinat d’un jeune homme à Markala
article_manifest.summary: Three suspects were arrested on Thursday 19 November 2026 as part of the investigation into the murder of a young man, which took place on 12 November in Markala, 35 km from Ségou. The victim had been killed on a construction site belonging to his brother. According to local sources, the suspects are being held at the gendarmerie.

article_manifest.title: Mali: Algerian secret services reportedly seeking to resume mediation with the FLA, according to Africa Intelligence
article_manifest.original_title: Mali : les services secrets algériens chercheraient à rétablir la médiation avec le FLA, selon Africa Intelligence
article_manifest.summary: The Algerian secret services are reportedly seeking to re-establish a channel of dialogue between the Malian authorities and the National Movement for the Liberation of Azawad (MNLA), according to Africa Intelligence. "As a new offensive by armed groups looms, the Algerian secret services are struggling to reactivate channels of mediation between the Malian state and the Tuareg rebels allied with the jihadists of GSIM," wrote the specialised media outlet on X, on 24 November 2026.

article_manifest.title: "Don't leave, stay in the country": Racky Aidara becomes a victim of cyberbullying after her advice
article_manifest.original_title: « Ne partez pas, restez au pays » : Racky Aidara victime de cyberharcèlement après ses conseils
article_manifest.summary: "Don't leave, stay in the country": Racky Aidara victim of cyberharassment after her advice Given the deaths in clandestine emigration in recent weeks, all Senegalese opinion leaders are talking about it and advising young people who are thinking of doing so. As the tragedies of clandestine emigration have multiplied in recent weeks, there are an increasing number of Senegalese voices calling on young people to give up on leaving.

article_manifest.source: AMAP (Agence Malienne de Presse et de Publicité)
article_manifest.title: China-Solomon Islands: Beijing defends its cooperation in the Pacific
article_manifest.original_title: Chine-Îles Salomon : Pékin défend sa coopération dans le Pacifique
article_manifest.summary: Bamako, 24 November (AMAP) China stated on Tuesday that its cooperation with Pacific island countries is not aimed at geopolitical competition or confrontation between blocs, amid reports of a possible non-renewal of its security agreement with the Solomon Islands. "China is developing its relations with the Solomon Islands on the basis of mutual respect and equality," said Chinese Foreign Ministry spokesperson Guo Jiakun at a press briefing in Beijing.

article_manifest.title: The Minister Delegate for Defence welcomes servicemen released from captivity
article_manifest.original_title: Le ministre délégué à la Défense reçoit des militaires libérés de captivité
article_manifest.summary: The Minister Delegate for Defence welcomes soldiers released from captivity General Oumar Diarra, Minister Delegate to the Minister of Defence, welcomed Malian soldiers recently released from captivity on 23 November 2026. These soldiers had been captured during the coordinated attacks of 25 April 2026, particularly in the Kidal region. According to Major General Elizée Jean Dao, Chief of Staff of the Army, their release is the result of a major operation carried out by the command.

article_manifest.title: Soldiers freed in Mali: spectacular raid by the FAMA and Africa Corps, or an operation carried out without fighting?
article_manifest.original_title: Militaires libérés au Mali : raid spectaculaire des Fama et d’Africa Corps ou opération menée sans combat ?
article_manifest.summary: Soldiers freed in Mali: spectacular raid by the FAMa and Africa Corps, or operation carried out without a fight? On 18 November, the Malian army and its Russian partners announced that they had freed 24 soldiers being held near Kidal. But behind the spectacular images released by Africa Corps, the reality of the operation is said to be less heroic.

article_manifest.title: Urban security: around thirty unlicensed taxis seized during an inspection operation in Niamey
article_manifest.original_title: Sécurité urbaine : une trentaine de taxis clandestins saisis lors d’une opération de contrôle à Niamey
article_manifest.summary: As part of its efforts to regulate and make urban transport safer, the Urban Transport Department of the City of Niamey (DTU) carried out an operation this weekend to check and sweep for vehicles operating without regulatory authorisation, particularly in markets and busy areas of the capital. The operation, which covered several neighbourhoods and junctions in the capital, resulted in the seizure of vehicles used for the illegal transport of people, including around thirty unlicensed taxis.

article_manifest.title: Lutte contre la criminalité à Zinder : six récidivistes, dont une femme, arrêtés pour au moins cinq vols commis moins d’un an après leur sortie de prison
article_manifest.original_title: Lutte contre la criminalité à Zinder : six récidivistes, dont une femme, arrêtés pour au moins cinq vols commis moins d’un an après leur sortie de prison
article_manifest.summary: Un réseau criminel de six individus, dont une femme, spécialisé dans les cambriolages nocturnes, les vols par effraction et le recel, a été démantelé par le Service interrégional de la Police judiciaire de Zinder (SIRPJ/Zr). Interpellés à la suite d’une opération menée dans la nuit du 17 au 18 novembre 2026 au quartier Jaguindi, les suspects, tous de nationalité nigérienne et âgés de 30 à 77 ans, ont reconnu avoir commis au moins cinq vols depuis leur sortie de prison, il y a moins d’un an.

article_manifest.title: Handling JNIM’s Threat to the Sahel’s Urban Heartlands
article_manifest.original_title: Handling JNIM’s Threat to the Sahel’s Urban Heartlands
article_manifest.summary: Over the last few years, the al-Qaeda affiliate in the Sahel has staged ever more daring assaults on the region’s cities. Pursuing military victory over the jihadists would further raise the steep human cost. Exploring a negotiated solution may prove the least harmful option.
